title: Rosalind and the Ghost
author: Juniper Thackeray
blurb: August Delacroix, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
